lines.zh: 鳍拍着冰面，一路滑过去。
lines.en: Flippers slap the ice as I slide along.
The ice water is freezing, just right for me.
Belly on the frost, faster than walking.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在岸上只是两根桨。
lines.en: On land my flippers are only two paddles.
Where is this ice floe drifting to?

lines.zh: 胖身子一滚，雪就开了道。
lines.en: One roll of my fat body opens a path in snow.
A seal always walks like it is apologizing.
Fish are moving beneath the ice crack.
I shuffle along with the tide's direction.

lines.zh: 鳍下打滑，我装作是故意的。
lines.en: My flippers slip; I pretend it was on purpose.
Three steps, one rest, puffing white breath.

lines.zh: 这片海岸我闭眼也认得。
lines.en: I know this shore even with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 冰面响一声，我先听一听。
lines.en: The ice creaks once, and I stop to listen.
I come ashore just to sun my belly.

lines.zh: 我把肚子压在冰上，往前蹭。
lines.en: I press my belly to the ice and scoot forward.

lines.zh: 前鳍一撑，我挪过半块浮冰。
lines.en: A push of my flippers carries me across the floe.
The snow is deep, so I just roll a while.

lines.zh: 我沿着冰缘走，脚下滑得很。
lines.en: I walk the ice edge, slipping all the way.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，数到七就忘了。
lines.en: I count the waves and lose track at seven.
A layer of white frost hangs on my whiskers.

lines.zh: 呼吸在空气里结成小云。
lines.en: My breath turns into little clouds.

lines.zh: 有鱼路过，我用眼神留它。
lines.en: A fish passes; I try to hold it with my eyes.
The water under the ice sounds better than wind.
I tuck my nose between my front flippers.
This rock has warmed up just right.

lines.zh: 冰面上睡一半，水里睡一半。
lines.en: I sleep half on the ice, half in the water.

lines.zh: 远处有冰山在慢慢地挪。
lines.en: A distant iceberg is slowly on the move.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的心跳很慢。
lines.en: I hear my own heartbeat, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 海豹不说话，嗷一声就够。
lines.en: A seal needs no words; one bark will do.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收进身下暖着。
lines.en: I tuck my tail beneath me for warmth.
Snow settles on my back; I do not shake it off.
I still have a while before the tide comes.
Do you smell of fish?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子只能抬这么高。
lines.en: I look up at you; my neck goes only this high.
Are you here to trade for one ride?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，等一条鱼。
lines.en: I stare at your hands, waiting for a fish.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我旁边的薄冰。
lines.en: You cracked the thin ice beside me.
Not the top of my head; it is ticklish.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我的太阳。
lines.en: Your shadow has covered my sunshine.

lines.zh: 我歪头，把你的样子记下来。
lines.en: I tilt my head and memorize your shape.

lines.zh: 你也是从冷海里来的吗？
lines.en: Did you come from the cold sea too?

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，霜从睫毛掉了。
lines.en: I blink, and frost falls from my lashes.
It hurts; I pull my flippers under me.
Even thick hide cannot stop that blow.

lines.zh: 我嗷了一声，声音都破了。
lines.en: I bark once, and my voice cracks.

lines.zh: 血滴在冰上，红得很显眼。
lines.en: Blood on the ice stands out bright red.
I retreat to the water; the water is safe.
Who hit me? I turn my head to find out.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我没脂肪的地方。
lines.en: That landed where I have no blubber.
My breathing has grown rough.

lines.zh: 我压住伤口，用肚子盖着。
lines.en: I press the wound, covering it with my belly.
I will remember the weight of that blow.
A live fish! You should have shown it sooner.
One fish buys you one ride.
I clap my flippers like applause.

lines.zh: 腥味一飘，我整只都醒了。
lines.en: One whiff of fish and all of me wakes up.
Stop waving it; point the fish head at me.

lines.zh: 我咽了口口水，声音很响。
lines.en: I swallow, and the sound is very loud.
This fish is fat enough; you have my approval.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一尺，又停下。
lines.en: I shuffle a foot forward, then stop.
Not from a net; it has to be alive.

lines.zh: 交易成了，趴下让你上来。
lines.en: Deal made; I lie down so you can climb on.
All this blubber of mine bounces when hit.
You stepped on my flipper; easy there.

lines.zh: 冰面太滑，我们撞成一团。
lines.en: The ice is slippery; we bump into a heap.
I shuffle aside to make you a path.
Do not push; once I roll I cannot stop.
I grunt once to show it is fine.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖顶到我的肚子。
lines.en: Your knee poked my belly.
We are both slipping on the ice.
I nudge back with my nose, very gently.
Squeezed together is warmer; let it be.

lines.zh: 我的叫声在冰谷里回荡。
lines.en: My call echoes down the ice valley.

lines.zh: 我在浮冰上等她游过来。
lines.en: I wait on the floe for her to swim over.

lines.zh: 她也喜欢冷得刺骨的水。
lines.en: She likes water cold enough to sting, as I do.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，谁也不超谁。
lines.en: We swim side by side, neither passing the other.

lines.zh: 我用胡须碰了碰她的胡须。
lines.en: I touch her whiskers with mine.

lines.zh: 这声音你学不来，太低了。
lines.en: You cannot copy this sound; it is too low.

lines.zh: 冬天才是我们成家的季节。
lines.en: Winter is the season we make our family.

lines.zh: 冰洞边那块雪，留给我们。
lines.en: That snow by the ice hole is ours to keep.
She laughs, and even her whiskers shake.

lines.zh: 明年这时，会多一只小的。
lines.en: By this time next year, there will be a small one.
You cannot lift me; I am grown.
A bucket? I stopped fitting long ago.
Do not lift my tail; it will slip.

lines.zh: 我这一身油，抱起来费劲。
lines.en: All this blubber makes me hard to hold.
Put me down; I can get there myself.
That is a flipper, not a handle.

lines.zh: 我在你怀里，像一袋湿沙。
lines.en: In your arms I am a sack of wet sand.
Be gentle; my bones are not thick.
Save the bucket for small fish; I stay here.

lines.zh: 抬一半就好，剩下的我滚。
lines.en: Lift half of me; I will roll the rest.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我先看。
lines.en: Something moved over there; I look first.

lines.zh: 你靠近得太快了，退半步。
lines.en: You came too fast; take half a step back.
I put myself between the pup and you.

lines.zh: 谁在冰上敲？我竖起耳朵。
lines.en: Who is knocking on the ice? My ears prick up.
That smell is wrong; it is not fish.
I lower my body, ready to dive.
Your footsteps are heavy; I hear them.
I keep my eyes on that long thing.
There is movement along the shoreline.
I will not chase, but I will remember you.
I back to the water's edge, one step away.
You stay still, and so do I.
I chase faster beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 水里是我的地盘，岸上随你。
lines.en: The water is mine; the shore is yours.

lines.zh: 我发出低低的哼声警告。
lines.en: I let out a low, warning hum.
One more step and I slide into the sea.

lines.zh: 我挡着这个冰洞的出口。
lines.en: I am blocking the way out of this ice hole.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高，我就跟着看。
lines.en: You raise the fish, and my gaze follows it.
We do not fight; we only stare.
The tide will help me; no need to rush.
I slap the water once with my tail.

lines.zh: 牙齿只用来咬鱼，不用来咬你。
lines.en: My teeth are for fish, not for you.

lines.zh: 我顶你一下，是提醒不是攻击。
lines.en: I bump you as a warning, not an attack.

lines.zh: 鳍甩过去，声音比力气大。
lines.en: My flipper swings louder than it hits.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我一口能咬断鱼骨。
lines.en: Do not push me; I can snap a fish spine.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖子又松口。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve, then let go.
That was light; I held back.
I rolled onto you; purely an accident.
The seawater pushed you for me.
Once done, I retreat into my ice hole.
I poke my head up through the broken ice.

lines.zh: 冷海把我送到这片岸上。
lines.en: The cold sea carried me to this shore.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，肺里全是寒气。
lines.en: First breath, and my lungs fill with cold air.
There is one more seal on the floe now.
I shake the ice chips off my back.
This bay has fish enough for me.

lines.zh: 我出生就会游泳，不用教。
lines.en: I could swim at birth; no one taught me.

lines.zh: 远处冰山在响，像打招呼。
lines.en: A far iceberg cracks, like a greeting.
I count my companions: there are three.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我先占这块石头。
lines.en: The tide is out; I claim this rock first.

lines.zh: 冰面留下我第一道滑痕。
lines.en: My first slide leaves a mark on the ice.
I can smell which way the fish shoal went.
The flames make my blubber burn hot.

lines.zh: 从冰崖摔下，肚子先着地。
lines.en: I fell from the ice cliff, belly first.

lines.zh: 我本该不怕水，这次却喘不上。
lines.en: I should not fear water, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 冰面被炸开，我掉进黑水。
lines.en: The ice is blown open; I drop into black water.
That arrow stuck in my thick hide.

lines.zh: 有东西钻进我的骨头里。
lines.en: Something is crawling into my bones.

lines.zh: 鱼群游远了，我饿得发软。
lines.en: The fish moved on; hunger makes me weak.

lines.zh: 闪电劈开冰面，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning splits the ice; my ears ring.
Beneath me is neither ice nor water.
